quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter emphasizes fundamental basketball training for Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Everything fundamental. When I kick it to him and transition, he ran down, but right now we're just having him here.

text_blocks.speaker: Lethal Shooter
text_blocks.text: I'll be the passer. Right now we're just going to do numbers. When I kick it to him and transition, he ran down, but right now we're just having him here. When I kick it to you, Jay, you just sweep across, come here, shot, nice and easy.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter explains the importance of high-intensity training
quotes.excerpt: In a real game, he would go back there for about 15 seconds. We want him to get pushed.
quotes.quote: In a real game, he would go back there for about 15 seconds. We want him to get pushed today, the heart rate up, because at the end, he has to make nine in a row.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter emphasizes the importance of deep shots in training
quotes.excerpt: I want you to take a really deep one. After you do your dribble, take another really deep one.
quotes.quote: Don't forget the biggest goal we want to change. I'm not your trainer, but if I was your trainer, I want you to take a really deep one. After you do your dribble, take another really deep one, and then no hesitation.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter highlights the intensity of the training session
quotes.excerpt: In a real game, let's just do one real game because that was intense.
quotes.quote: In a real game, let's just do one real game because that was intense. Hands off your hips, please. Take a deep breath, you're getting ready for war right now.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter explains the importance of maintaining focus during shooting drills
quotes.excerpt: When you start hitting a lot of shots, you start doing this. I want you to stay focused.
quotes.quote: When you start hitting a lot of shots, you start doing this. I want you to stay focused. And then if you do want to drop it quick, I'm here and I'm still seeing my target, and then I come back.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter emphasizes the importance of the jab step in basketball
quotes.excerpt: I just feel like sometimes the jab is like right here. It's just sometimes, not every single time.
quotes.quote: I just feel like sometimes the jab is like right here. It's just sometimes, not every single time, that he could just drop down and just bring it over sometimes. To make the person feel like, oh shit, he's about to go.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter emphasizes the importance of footwork and reading the defender
quotes.excerpt: I don't want you to do that. I want you to pick it up. I want you to pick it up.
quotes.quote: I don't want you to do that. I want you to pick it up. I want you to pick it up to read them, because if he don't step back, what am I going to do? I'm going to shoot that motherfucker.

quotes.speaker: Lethal Shooter
quotes.summary_phrase: Lethal Shooter emphasizes the importance of high endurance training
quotes.excerpt: I spoke with coaches as well, today was high endurance. So if you notice, you might be shooting 30.
quotes.quote: I spoke with coaches as well, today was high endurance. So if you notice, you might be shooting 30, but you was only getting like a split second in between each break. So that was a very compact training session, so at the end, I wasn't really mad with the miss shots. The only thing I was mad was the way we missed.

quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown discusses the importance of efficiency and fundamentals
quotes.excerpt: Efficiency, that's the keyword for the summer. Chat, I see you when I look at you. No words.
quotes.quote: Efficiency, that's the keyword for the summer. Chat, I see you when I look at you. No words. Straight to work. I'm ready. I ain't no young gun no more. I ain't no young gun. Chat, we working. That's it. No words. Straight to work.
